净值已扣双边交易成本 10.0 bp（换手率 × 费率）；多空/十分层均含停牌股剔除（收益为 NaN 不参与）。
设计意图： Extends the drawdown geometry factor by incorporating volume-confirmed recovery. The parent's recovery slope is multiplied by relative volume rank so that only recoveries accompanied by elevated volume contribute strongly, introducing nonlinear interaction that can improve MI. Depth and duration components remain additive to preserve rank stability.

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

ts_corr(DD) + ts_corr(Dur) + ts_corr(Rec) * ts_corr(V/MA20_V)
依赖列: close, volume

📐 因子表达式 DSL (FactorEngine)

ts_corr(DD) + ts_corr(Dur) + ts_corr(Rec) * ts_corr(V/MA20_V)
已转 FactorEngine（真实 DSL，parse_expr 验证通过）

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. add —— 加法
    add(add(ts_corr(DD), ts_corr(Dur)), multiply(ts_corr(Rec), ts_corr(divide(V, MA20_V))))
  2. 2. add —— 加法
    add(ts_corr(DD), ts_corr(Dur))
  3. 3. ts_corr —— 两序列过去 N 天滚动相关
    ts_corr(DD)
  4. 4. ts_corr —— 两序列过去 N 天滚动相关
    ts_corr(Dur)
  5. 5. multiply —— 乘法
    multiply(ts_corr(Rec), ts_corr(divide(V, MA20_V)))
  6. 6. ts_corr —— 两序列过去 N 天滚动相关
    ts_corr(Rec)
  7. 7. ts_corr —— 两序列过去 N 天滚动相关
    ts_corr(divide(V, MA20_V))
  8. 8. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(V, MA20_V)

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
DD回撤深度（drawdown，历史高点到当前价的回撤幅度）
Dur回撤持续时间（drawdown duration，自峰值以来的期数）
Rec回撤恢复参与度（drawdown recovery 相关自定义量）
V成交量（Volume 简称）

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 1) depth = (peak_N - close) / peak_N 回撤深度
  2. 2) duration = 自从达到 peak 至今的天数
  3. 3) recovery = (close - low_since_peak) / (peak - low_since_peak) 恢复强度
  4. 4) vol_ratio = volume / ts_mean(volume, 20)
  5. 5) 各子信号 cs_rank → 0~1 分位
  6. 6) score = rank(depth) + rank(duration) + rank(recovery) * rank(vol_ratio)
  7. 7) factor = cs_rank(score)
来源：手写步骤（factor_manual_61 / formula_lqtp 人工核对）

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_drawdown_volume_complexity(df): """Mutated drawdown geometry with volume-confirmed recovery.""" df_copy = df.copy() rolling_high = df_copy["close"].rolling(window=252, min_periods=20).max() drawdown = (rolling_high - df_copy["close"]) / rolling_high new_peak = df_copy["close"] >= rolling_high group = new_peak.cumsum() duration = new_peak.groupby(group).cumcount() recovery = -drawdown.diff(5) vol_ma = df_copy["volume"].rolling(window=20).mean() rel_volume = df_copy["volume"] / vol_ma rank_dd = drawdown.rank(pct="kw">class="kw">True) rank_dur = duration.rank(pct="kw">class="kw">True) rank_rec = recovery.rank(pct="kw">class="kw">True) rank_vol = rel_volume.rank(pct="kw">class="kw">True) confirmed_recovery = rank_rec * rank_vol df_copy["factor_drawdown_volume_complexity"] = rank_dd + rank_dur + confirmed_recovery "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_drawdown_volume_complexity"]
